name: Aarakocra
description: Dive Attack. If you are flying and dive at least 30 ft. straight toward a target and then hit it with a melee weapon attack, the attack deals an extra 1d6 damage to the target. Talons. You are proficient with your unarmed strikes, which deal 1d4 slashing damage on a hit. Language. You can speak, read, and write Auran.
